run_tokenize_file: run the preprocess module to tokenize a text file and save tokens as a pickle file
run_apply_tokenizer: run the apply_tokenizer function to batch encode lines from a text file into token IDs
run_save_tensor: run the save function to write a PyTorch tensor to a pickle file on disk
review_apply_tokenizer: review the apply_tokenizer function to understand how it batches lines and handles text normalization
refactor_tokenize_file: refactor the tokenize_file function to support streaming tokenization for very large files
